title: Duplicate work is detected while creating new work items in the global navigation
description:
Jira Cloud now helps you avoid creating duplicate work items by flagging potential duplicates during the creation process. When you create new work items using the global navigation, Jira identifies similar work and alerts you, saving time and keeping your spaces organized. Select Create from the top navigation bar in Jira.
	Start entering details for your new work item.
	Look for a list of potential duplicates that appears as you type.
	Review the suggested work items to see if the work already
